div.div: مُجْنَأٌ A shield: (S, K:) so called because of its being humped, (K, TA, [in some copies of the former of which, for لِٱحْدِيدَابِهِ, we find لَا حَدِيدَةَ بِهِ, i. e. having no piece of iron in it,]) and on account of its bending form. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
